description: This header file defines utility functions for converting between Android binder status codes and native status_t values, specifically for handling exceptions and errors in the Android binder IPC mechanism within the android::gui::aidl_utils namespace.

methods.name: statusTFromExceptionCode
methods.description: Converts a binder exception code to a native status_t value, mapping specific exception codes to corresponding status_t constants.

methods.name: statusTFromBinderStatus
methods.description: Converts a binder::Status object to a native status_t, handling various error conditions and exception codes.

methods.name: binderStatusFromStatusT
methods.description: Creates a binder::Status object from a native status_t, mapping error codes to appropriate Java exceptions for binder communication.
